patch_description:
I’m replacing the line-entangler seed with a hierarchical butterfly-style circuit.  
Instead of spreading independent rotations across all qubits, this block uses mirrored parameter tying to enforce symmetry, then mixes information in two scales: local nearest-neighbor coupling and long-range cross-qubit coupling. A shared controlled rotation on each scale acts like a residual bottleneck, which should reduce overfitting, improve validation/test accuracy, and train faster with fewer effective degrees of freedom.
